title: Windows glab publishing mangled Chinese title
details:
- **What happened:** Python heredoc passed Chinese title through Windows Git Bash into `glab`, and GitLab stored mojibake in Issue #17; expected exact UTF-8 title. Follow-up correction attempts hit temp-path conversion and HTTP 415.
- **What the user said:** “发布失败必须报告已成功创建的真实编号，并使用精确标题去重后续重试。”
- **Repro:** From Git Bash on Windows, run a Python heredoc that invokes `glab api -X POST ... -f title=<Chinese text>` through `subprocess.run`; inspect stored issue title.
- **Evidence:** GitLab zyts/dtsf Issue #17; 2026-09-11; branch eam-ems.
